AC4: Given only Cancelled, No-show or Scheduled appointments, then Last visit shows "-".
TP-7 (integration): S-2/AC4. A patient with only non-Completed appointments gets null.

findings.suggested_fix: Add S-2/AC4 to TP-17's covers, or state in TP-7 that TP-17 provides the '-' check, as TP-8 does.
findings.text: S-2/AC4 requires the page to show '-', but TP-7 only checks for null in the API. TP-17 tests the '-' rendering but lists only S-2/AC5, so AC4's UI outcome is not traced.

findings.suggested_fix: Add an integration negative test: a list request that sorts by lastVisitAt is rejected or ignored as before, and the accepted sort options are unchanged.
findings.text: S-3/AC4 requires the sort options to stay the same and none to sort by Last visit. TP-12 only checks the column header. No test checks that the API sort keys still exclude lastVisitAt.

cites.quote: Every PRD requirement has at least one test whose name starts with its ID

findings.suggested_fix: Give each TP the REQ ID(s) its test name will start with (for example 'HMS-4 REQ-2, REQ-3: ...').
findings.text: The strategy requires each test name to start with its requirement ID. The plan maps TPs only to story ACs and never says the test names will carry HMS-4 REQ-n prefixes.

cites.quote: An invalid hospital zone setting falls back to Asia/Kolkata, as Next appointment does.

findings.suggested_fix: Split TP-17 into a null-rendering test and a zone-fallback test.
findings.text: TP-17 bundles two unrelated checks: '-' for a null value, and the fallback for an invalid hospital zone. If one fails, the report does not show which behaviour broke.

rubric_items.reason: All 17 ACs (S-1..S-5) map to at least one TP. Two are only partly asserted: S-2/AC4 never checks the '-' on the page, and the S-3/AC4 sort-options check is header-only.

API selection rules are tested at integration against a real DB. Rendering, time zone and format are tested as jsdom unit tests. No e2e and no manual tests. Each test sits at the cheapest level that proves it.

Covers null and no-Completed cases, the UTC/IST date boundary (AC2/AC3), the 21st-row paging boundary, an invalid filter and the zone fallback. Missing: a negative test that the API sort cannot use lastVisitAt.

Tools and folders match the strategy (Vitest+Supertest+PG16 with a fixed clock; Vitest+jsdom+Testing Library; api/test, web/src/__tests__). The plan does not say that test names must start with REQ IDs.
Titles are concrete and a tester can run them. TP-17 bundles two unrelated checks, and TP-8's title promises a page check that the test does not make.
